svg.title: US221 — Average turnaround time per aircraft model (statistics aggregated across replicas)

g.text: US221 — Average turnaround time per aircraft model (statistics aggregated across replicas)
Averaging the averages of each replica would be wrong
so replicas exchange sums and counts.
A peer request (X-Peer-Hops) is answered with the local partial report only.
The same pattern is used by US117 (maintenance hours) and US220 (costs per aircraft / per model).
